threat.intent: danger, loss of control, potential harm
threat.perception: Source and danger relationship must be perceived before flight.
threat.acting: Gaze locks on hazard; spine tightens; protective shift; retreat when justified.
threat.camera: Preserve geography; low-angle or shot/reverse-shot to show size; controlled withholding before reveal.
threat.sound: Close transient plus low-frequency body; ambience withdraws at recognition; source position retained.
threat.edit: Delay source reveal just enough to generate suspense, then show unambiguous cause.
threat.risk: Avoid horror-style shake that hides contact or makes timing incoherent.

comedy.intent: surprise, contrast, embarrassment or harmless incongruity
comedy.perception: Audience may discover the setup before character; pause makes joke readable.
comedy.acting: Clear straight pose, short thought pause, contrasting exaggerated reaction, recover deliberately.
comedy.camera: Locked wide or held composition preserves the setup and payoff in same geography.
comedy.sound: Character-scale effect, comic tonal contrast and purposeful gap; do not overfill.
comedy.edit: Hold slightly longer on mismatch; cut at payoff not at arbitrary motion.
comedy.risk: Overacting and over-editing can hide the underlying gag.

wonder.perception: Reveal evidence progressively so audience shares discovery.
wonder.acting: Eyes travel first; shoulders relax; cautiously approach with gentle weight shift.
wonder.camera: Allow wide context followed by motivated reveal, slow follow or upward framing.
wonder.sound: Subtle atmosphere and harmonics without falsely assigning an impossible source.
wonder.edit: Permit observation and visual breath; do not cut before recognition.
wonder.risk: Constant slow camera motion without subject-led attention is decorative.

tenderness.perception: Both participants must understand the offered contact or support.
tenderness.acting: Lower threat posture, soften hands/shoulders, wait for recipient acknowledgement.
tenderness.camera: Stable medium/two-shot; reaction close-ups only after contact geography is clear.
tenderness.sound: Close, restrained cloth/breath/material Foley; music makes room for tiny cues.
tenderness.edit: Hold contact and follow-through long enough for emotional change.
tenderness.risk: Do not imply touching or emotional bonding without actual contact/response.
